# telnyx_ai_test_schedule (Data Source)

A schedule that runs AI test framework scenarios on a cron expression.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.

### Read-Only

- `agent` (Number) ID of the test agent the job belongs to.
- `created_at` (String)
- `crontab_expression` (String) Cron expression controlling when the job runs, in the job's timezone.
- `execution_mode` (String) Execution mode for the test runs, such as voice, text, or sip.
- `frequency` (Number)
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `notify_on` (String) When the job sends a notification. One of `both`, `failure`, `never`, `success`.
- `personalities` (List of Number)
- `personality` (Number)
- `run_as_text` (Boolean) Whether the job runs scenarios as text chat rather than voice calls.
- `scenario_ids` (List of Number) Scenario IDs the job executes.
- `scenarios_data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scenarios_data))
- `tags` (List of String)
- `timezone` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--scenarios_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scenarios_data`

Read-Only:

- `agent` (Number)
- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `personality` (Number)
- `personality_name` (String)
